title: Personal Checking: Wire, Official Check and Account Research Fees
content:
This price list covers the Personal Checking services that are charged per use: sending and receiving wires, buying an official (cashier's) check, and customer-requested research on the account.

| Tier | Outgoing domestic wire | Outgoing international wire | Incoming wire | Official check | Account research, per hour |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 30.00 | 50.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 | 25.00 |
| Student Checking | 30.00 | 50.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 | 25.00 |
| Everyday Checking | 30.00 | 50.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 | 25.00 |
| Interest Checking | 30.00 | 50.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 | 25.00 |
| Premier Checking | 20.00 | 40.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 25.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 10.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

All amounts are in USD.

## What each column prices

- **Outgoing domestic wire** — each wire sent to a U.S. destination.
- **Outgoing international wire** — each wire sent abroad.
- **Incoming wire** — each wire credited to the account.
- **Official check** — each official (cashier's) check the account pays for.
- **Account research, per hour** — research or reconciliation the customer asks for, priced per hour with a one-hour minimum.

## Observations

- The four lower tiers share one price list; Premier Checking lowers the wire prices and drops the incoming wire and official check charges; Private Client Checking lowers wire prices further and also drops the research charge.
- Hypothetical example: a customer on Everyday Checking who sends one domestic and one international wire in a month pays 30.00 and 50.00 USD for them respectively.
